name: Honda Hobbit PA50
engine: 49 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, oil injection, automatic, pedals
intro: Honda's pedal moped. Two-stroke with oil injection, a variator and pedals to start it.

B: It has oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump line for cracks.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
